result.summary: Rework for FAIL of handoffs/E2E105-20261105-01/step-05b-test-design-validator.json (gate pass 1 of 3), findings F1, F2 and F3; fixed in the tests only. What failed: the gate's own server mutants W01 and W02 (a text of tenant A put into the questionnaire answer of tenant B) survived the test `isolation` in both pairs, because the set 'texts of A that B does not have' was built against B's answer of the server under test, so a leaked text left the set (F1), and B's JSON answers were compared with the texts of A by whole string values only, so a text of A inside a string of B was not seen (F2); the starter mutants V12 and V13 (no wait for the group after the final SIGKILL of stop() and of a failed start) survived, because the starter tests only waited themselves afterwards (F3). What was fixed, by criterion 6 of REQ-105 as decisions/0109 О17 reads it and by design 4.1: (1) tools/test/e2e/picker.e2e.js builds the set against B's tenant file in ru (the name, the intro, and the title, help, unit and option labels of each question), the texts of A still come from GET /t/<A>/api/questionnaire?lang=ru, the control of at least 10 stays, and the same set is used for B's card text; (2) in B's questionnaire answer and B's result answer a text of A that has a blank is looked for as a part of every string value, a one-word text is compared with the whole string values, the solution names of A stay a part of the answer text, the card text check is unchanged (every text of A as a part); the comments say О17 and the two measured common words; (3) tools/test/e2e-stand.test.js asserts once that the process group is gone right after `await stand.stop()` in E2S-01 and E2S-13 and right after the rejection of the failed start in E2S-06, E2S-07 and E2S-08, keeping every bounded waitGone. The code under test is right by the criteria and was not touched: on the correct server the new oracle gives the same 49 and 23 texts and 0 hits in B's answers (measured before the edit), and the five starter tests are green in 206 runs each under load. Shown on copies outside the project: W01 and W02 red by a hit in both pairs; P13 red by a hit in pair 2 (in pair 1 its exact form stays red by the control, because there the address of A itself serves B); V13 red 10 of 10 in E2S-07 and in E2S-08; V12 red 11 of 11 in whole-file runs of e2e-stand.test.js but not reliably when E2S-13 runs alone (0 of 30 quiet, 18 of 30 under 8 busy loops) - a race with the system reaping an orphan, reported with the numbers in issue I1, nothing loosened. Counts not lower; npm run check exit 0; npm run -s e2e -- picker 17124, 17014, 17038 ms. Next by the route: TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR (step 5b again, pass 2 of 3) for the two test files, then TEST-RUNNER.

issues.text: V12 (stop() does not wait for the group after its final SIGKILL) cannot be made red reliably by a check in this write set; it is reported with the numbers, nothing is loosened. The new check of E2S-13 makes it red in 11 of 11 runs of the whole e2e-stand.test.js (the way npm test runs it), but E2S-13 alone is red in 0 of 30 runs on a quiet machine and 18 of 30 under 8 busy loops. Cause: after the main process has ended, the only member of the group is the child that ignored SIGTERM; its parent is gone, so the system reaps it, not the test process, and whether it is gone in the fraction of a millisecond between the SIGKILL and the check is a race. E2S-01 cannot catch V12 at all (0 of 5: its stand-in is the only member of its group and the test process reaps it before stop() goes on). A catcher that does not depend on timing needs a member of the group that a live process keeps unreaped after the SIGKILL; a Node-only stand-in cannot make one (the parent of every member is itself in the group, decisions/0109 addendum of 2026-11-08 on О13), and tools/test/fixtures/e2e-stand/fake-stand.js is outside this write set. For ORCH: record V12 as a mutant caught only in whole-file runs, or give the question to TEST-DESIGNER / CODE-DESIGNER.

V13 is red without luck in E2S-07 and E2S-08 (10 of 10 each): the killed stand-in is a child of the test process, which cannot reap it before its event loop turns, and there is no await between the rejection and the check. E2S-06 cannot catch V13 (0 of 10): its stand-in ended by itself and was reaped before the start failed, so no group is left for the missing wait. The checks of E2S-06 and E2S-01 still pin the contract of 4.1 and are green in every run.

P13 in its exact form stays red by the control in pair 1 ('uchet-pro then svet-marketing: 0 texts of A'): under it the address of A itself serves svet-marketing, so A has no text that B lacks (0 by both oracles, measured) and there is nothing to leak; the test stops at its first failure and never reaches pair 2. Red by a hit is shown with the same edit limited to the folder demo-tenants-v3: 'agency then stock: the card of B shows «Лидвейв»'; the test before the edit gave only 'agency then stock: 0 texts of A' there.

For DOC-UPDATER at step 10: design 4.4 (the helper row 'exclusiveStrings(qA, qB)') and section 8 row 6 describe the oracle before О17; the test now takes B's tenant file (exclusiveStrings(questionnaireA, tenantFileB)) and the rule of О17 for the JSON answers, together with the precision of criterion 6 that О17 already assigns.

The count of the substring 'test(' in picker.e2e.js rises from 11 to 12 only because of the call /\s/u.test(text) of the new hasBlank; the top-level tests stay nine. The temporary root holds sai-stand-test-lvEDJb of 2026-11-05, not of this step (noted by the gate too); left as it is.
